Cohort: Yaniel

When you defeat a bane that has the Demon trait, roll 1d6; on a 1, summon and encounter the henchman Shamira.

When you display a Blessing of Nocticula next to this scenario, if the number displayed is at least equal to the number of characters, you may win the scenario.
